- Erlaubte Elemente im Fragment: `div`, `p`, `h4`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `code`,
  `strong`, `em`, `a`, `span`, `table`, `thead`, `tbody`, `tr`, `th`, `td`.
  Keine Skripte, keine Stile, keine Bilder, kein `<svg>` (Diagramme siehe unten).
- Alle Tags korrekt geschlossen und verschachtelt.

## Belegpflicht

- Jede fachliche Aussage ist zu belegen. Belege stammen ausschließlich aus dem
  Payload des Prompts; nichts darf aus anderem Wissen als Beleg ausgegeben werden.
- Verweis auf ein Spezifikationselement oder Requirement (nur IDs, die im
  Payload vorkommen):

  Link setzt der Generator.
- Verweis auf eine Dokumentstelle (nur Dokument/Seite aus dem Payload):
  `<span class="docref" data-doc="<Dokument-ID>" data-page="<Seite>">Kurzname §x.y „Titel“</span>`.
- Niemals URLs ausgeben, insbesondere keine PDF-URLs.

## Annahmen (Wissenslücken)

- Wo die Quellen schweigen, sind höchstens 3 Annahmen je Text und 2 je

- Jede Annahme ist im Text als Interpretation erkennbar („dürfte“, „vermutlich“,

  `<!-- annahmen: 1) … – Begründung: … -->` aufgezählt.
- Reicht das Budget nicht, wird der Aspekt weggelassen — niemals unmarkiert

## Diagramme

Ein Diagramm nur, wenn es gegenüber dem Text Mehrwert bietet:

- Sequenzdiagramm: Abläufe ab 3 Schritten oder mit nicht offensichtlicher
  Reihenfolge/Asynchronität.
- Kontext-/Kollaborationsdiagramm: ab 3 beteiligten Komponenten.
- Zustandsdiagramm: Lebenszyklen und Zustandsmaschinen.
- Aktivitätsdiagramm: Entscheidungs- oder Verarbeitungsabläufe mit Verzweigung.
- Keine Trivialdiagramme (einzelne Aufrufe, Getter/Setter, Zweierbeziehungen).

Beschriftungen deutsch, Bezeichner unverändert. Jedes Diagramm steht im

<div class="ai-lang-notice" style="background:#fef3c7; border:1px solid #fde68a; color:#92400e; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:6px; margin:8px 0 12px 0; font-size:0.85rem;">ℹ️ <strong>Editorial notice:</strong> This technical guide is currently undergoing translation. The original reference version is shown below.</div>
  <h4>Verwendung und Semantik</h4>
  <p>Die synchrone Funktion <code>IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount</code> (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91020">[SWS_IdsM_91020]</a>) dient als Schnittstelle für Smart-Sensoren, um Sicherheitsereignisse (Security Events, SEv) mit einem Zeitstempel und einem Zählwert an das Modul <code>IdsM</code> zu melden. Die Funktion besitzt keinen Rückgabewert und nimmt folgende Parameter entgegen:</p>
  <ul>
    <li><code>securityEventId</code>: Die Kennung des aufgetretenen Sicherheitsereignisses (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91020">[SWS_IdsM_91020]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>timestamp</code>: Zeitstempel zur zeitlichen Referenzierung des Sicherheitsereignisses (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91020">[SWS_IdsM_91020]</a>).</li>
    <li><code>count</code>: Zählwert, der als Startwert für das Sicherheitsereignis verwendet wird (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91020">[SWS_IdsM_91020]</a>). Falls ein Ereignis mit Zeitstempel gemeldet wird, für das zuvor kein Zähler berechnet wurde, kann der Aufruf mit <code>count = 1</code> erfolgen (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00405" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00405">[SWS_IdsM_00405]</a>).</li>
  </ul>

  <h4>Zusammenspiel bei der Ereignisverarbeitung</h4>
  <p>Ist das Zeitstempel-Feature aktiviert und wird ein Sicherheitsereignis über diesen Dienst mit dem Parameter <code>timestamp</code> übergeben, nutzt das IdsM diesen übergebenen Zeitstempel für die Speicherung oder Übertragung des qualifizierten Sicherheitsereignisses (QSEv) (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01108" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01108">[SWS_IdsM_01108]</a>). Wird das Ereignis bei aktivem Zeitstempel-Feature hingegen ohne Zeitstempelparameter gemeldet, setzt das IdsM das Optionsbit für den Zeitstempel im Protokoll-Header vor Übertragung oder Speicherung auf 0 (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01112" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01112">[SWS_IdsM_01112]</a>).</p>

  <h4>Fehlerbehandlung und Nebenläufigkeit</h4>
  <p>Die Funktion ist nicht reentrant (<code>Non Reentrant</code>) (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91020">[SWS_IdsM_91020]</a>). Bei aktivierter Entwicklungserkennung (<code>IdsMDevErrorDetect</code>) validiert das Modul die Parameter <code>securityEventId</code> und <code>count</code>: Falls eine unbekannte Ereignis-ID übergeben wird oder <code>count</code> gleich 0 ist, wird der Entwicklungsfehler <code>IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID</code> gemeldet (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_02105" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_02105">[SWS_IdsM_02105]</a>).</p>

  <p class="ai-note">Dieser Nutzungshinweis wurde automatisch auf Basis der AUTOSAR-Spezifikation R20-11 generiert.</p>
</div>

Falls ein Ereignis mit Zeitstempel gemeldet wird, für das zuvor kein Zähler berechnet wurde, kann der Aufruf mit <code>count = 1</code> erfolgen (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00405" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00405">[SWS_IdsM_00405]</a>).</li> </ul> <h4>Zusammenspiel bei der Ereignisverarbeitung</h4> <p>Ist das Zeitstempel-Feature aktiviert und wird ein Sicherheitsereignis über diesen Dienst mit dem Parameter <code>timestamp</code> übergeben, nutzt das IdsM diesen übergebenen Zeitstempel für die Speicherung oder Übertragung des qualifizierten Sicherheitsereignisses (QSEv) (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01108" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01108">[SWS_IdsM_01108]</a>). Wird das Ereignis bei aktivem Zeitstempel-Feature hingegen ohne Zeitstempelparameter gemeldet, setzt das IdsM das Optionsbit für den Zeitstempel im Protokoll-Header vor Übertragung oder Speicherung auf 0 (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01112" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01112">[SWS_IdsM_01112]</a>).</p> <h4>Fehlerbehandlung und Nebenläufigkeit</h4> <p>Die Funktion ist nicht reentrant (<code>Non Reentrant</code>) (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91020">[SWS_IdsM_91020]</a>). Bei aktivierter Entwicklungserkennung (<code>IdsMDevErrorDetect</code>) validiert das Modul die Parameter <code>securityEventId</code> und <code>count</code>: Falls eine unbekannte Ereignis-ID übergeben wird oder <code>count</code> gleich 0 ist, wird der Entwicklungsfehler <code>IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID</code> gemeldet (<a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_02105" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_02105">[SWS_IdsM_02105]</a>).</p> <p class="ai-note">Dieser Nutzungshinweis wurde automatisch auf Basis der AUTOSAR-Spezifikation R20-11 generiert.</p> </div>

LEITBILD (Umfang und Aufbau orientieren sich an den bewährten Adaptive-Modulleitfäden):
- 900–1600 Wörter in 5–8 thematischen Abschnitten mit <h4>-Überschriften, die das
  Modul erschließen (z. B. Rolle und Systemgrenze, zentrale Abläufe vom Start bis zur
  Nutzung, Daten- und Interaktionsformen, Betriebsregeln und Randbedingungen,
  Konfiguration/Instanzbezug, Verhalten im Fehlerfall). Die Überschriften sind
  modulspezifisch zu formulieren, nicht generisch.
- Ein Abschnitt „Verhalten im Fehlerfall“ und am Ende ein Abschnitt
  „Weiterführende Detailbelege“ (die wichtigsten Requirements/Dokumentstellen kurz
  eingeordnet).
- Jeder Absatz enthält mindestens einen Beleg (Requirement-ID oder Dokumentstelle).
- 4–10 Diagramme, wo sie Mehrwert bieten: Sequenzdiagramme für zentrale Abläufe,
  Zustandsdiagramme für Lebenszyklen, Kontext-/Kollaborationsdiagramme für die
  Einbettung, Aktivitätsdiagramme für Entscheidungen. Die Schaubilder der Spezifikation
  (Payload-Einträge mit "figure": true) sind Ausgangspunkt: übernimm ihre Aussage,
  wo sie den Text stützen, und verbessere ihre Lesbarkeit.
- Das Fragment beginnt mit <div class="ai module-guide"> und endet mit
  <p class="ai-note">…</p></div>.

AUSGABEFORMAT (verbindlich, nichts außerhalb dieser Blöcke):
<<<FRAGMENT
<div class="…"> … </div>
FRAGMENT>>>
Danach je Diagramm-Platzhalter genau ein Block:
<<<DIAGRAM diag-<kurzname> seq
<JSON nach dem Sequenz-Schema>
DIAGRAM>>>
oder
<<<DIAGRAM diag-<kurzname> dot
<Graphviz-digraph ohne Stilattribute (Farben/Schriften setzt der Generator)>
DIAGRAM>>>

Sequenz-Schema (JSON):
{"titel": str, "teilnehmer": [{"name": str}], "schritte": [
  {"art": "nachricht", "von": <idx>, "nach": <idx>, "text": [str], "pfeil": "voll"|"offen", "gestrichelt": bool},
  {"art": "selbst", "teilnehmer": <idx>, "text": [str]},
  {"art": "notiz", "ueber": [<idx>, <idx>], "text": [str]},
  {"art": "abschnitt", "text": str},
  {"art": "rahmen", "typ": "alt"|"opt"|"loop", "guard": str}, {"art": "trenner", "guard": str}, {"art": "rahmen-ende"}
]}
Antworten/Rückgaben: "pfeil": "offen", "gestrichelt": true. Zustands-, Kontext- und Aktivitätsdiagramme als dot.

 "module": "idsm",
 "platform": "classic",
 "release": "R20-11",
 "requirements": [
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00101",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file Det.h if the pa- rameter IdsMDevErrorDetect is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00102",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file Dem.h if the pa- rameter IdsMSinkDem is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00103",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file Dcm.h if the pa- rameter IdsMDiagnosticSupport is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00104",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file NvM.h if the pa- rameter IdsMNvmBlockDescriptor is configured."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00105",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall include the header file PduR.h if the parameter IdsMSinkIdsR is enabled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00202",
   "text": "A call to IdsM_Init initializes all internal variables and sets the IdsM module to the initialized state."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00203",
   "text": "If development error reporting is enabled via IdsMDevEr- rorDetect , the IdsM module shall call Det_ReportError with the error code IDSM_E_PARAM_UNINIT when any API other than IdsM_Init or IdsM_GetVer- sionInfo is called in uninitialized state."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00204",
   "text": "When IdsM_Init is called in initialized state, the IdsM mod- ule shall not re-initialize its internal variables. It shall instead call Det_ReportError with the error code IDSM_E_ALREADY_INITIALIZED if development error reporting is enabled (see IdsMDevErrorDetect )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00300",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with the service IdsM_- SetSecurityEvent when there no context data is reported."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00301",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with the service IdsM_- SetSecurityEventWithContextData when the optional context data is re- ported."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00401",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a counter calculated from a smart sensor with the service IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCount"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00402",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a counter calculated from a smart sensor, and additionally the SEv context data, with the service IdsM_- SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00403",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a timestamp and a counter calculated from a smart sensor with the service IdsM_SetSecurityEven- tWithTimestampCount"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00404",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to receive SEv s with a timestamp, a counter calculated from a smart sensor,and additionally the SEv context data, with the service IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00405",
   "text": "For reporting a SEv s with a timestamp but with no previously cal- culated counter, the services IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount- ContextData and IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount can be used with the counter value equals 1."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00501",
   "text": "The functions IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContext- Data , IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData and IdsM_SetSecu- rityEventWithTimestampCountContextData shall support a maximum length of 1500 bytes for the context data."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00502",
   "text": "The functions calling IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCon- textData , IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData and IdsM_Set- SecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData shall provide the context data pointer to a byte array where the context data is available."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00600",
   "text": "The IdsM module shall represent each SEv instance by an IdsMExternalEventId , a IdsMSensorInstanceId , a IdsMInternalEventId , and the related EventName. These combination of parameters shall be unique per IdsM instance represented by the ECU configuration."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00601",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have an IdsMInternalEventId . This param- eter shall not be configured manually. The IdsM shall calculate the value of this param- eter internally and shall publish the value in the parameter. This ID is used for internal handling of the SEv s."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00602",
   "text": "Sensors using the IdsM API to report SEv s shall not rely on the value of the parameter IdsMInternalEventId . Instead, they shall use the symbolic constant (SymbolicNameValue) of the corresponding SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00603",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have an external event ID IdsMExter- nalEventId , which is a global and unique ID per Security Event Type repre- sented by the ECU configuration, and it is defined in the SecXT ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00604",
   "text": "A IdsMExternalEventId with value 0xFFFF shall be consid- ered invalid."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00605",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have a sensor instance ID IdsMSensorIn- stanceId . This is the representation of the module number, in case there are many instances of the same module reporting to the IdsM."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00606",
   "text": "The combination of external event ID IdsMExternalEventId and sensor instance ID IdsMSensorInstanceId shall make the SEv s uniquely iden- tifiable within the configuration. This parameter tuple is represented by the Symbolic Name Value of the IdsMEvent Container."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00607",
   "text": "Sensors using the IdsM services shall report a SEv using the symbolic constant (SymbolicNameValue) of the IdsMEvent Container ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00608",
   "text": "Each SEv shall have a IdsMSensorInstanceId configured. In case there are several instances of the same sensor reporting SEv s with the same Event Definition ID in a ECU, the reporting entity shall be uniquely identified through the configuration parameter IdsMSensorInstanceId . In case there is only one instance of the module in the configuration, the value of the instance ID shall be, by default, set to 0 ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00701",
   "text": "The IdsM shall have a configurable number of event buffers IdsMNumberOfEventBuffers , depending on the amount of configured IdsMEvents that are to be handled."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00702",
   "text": "Upon reception of a SEv , the IdsM shall store the event in an Event Buffer until it can be further processed. Event buffers shall be handled and filtered asynchronously in the IdsM_MainFunction service."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00703",
   "text": "In case no Event Buffer is found. The IdsM inter- nal SEv 'No Event Buffer Available' shall be triggered, in case it has been configured."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00704",
   "text": "The IdsM shall have a configurable number of context data buffers IdsMNumberOfContextDataBuffers with different configurable sizes IdsMContextDataBufferSize in order to satisfy different sensor use cases."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00705",
   "text": "Upon reception of a SEv with context data, the IdsM shall store the context data in an Context Data Buffer with the most adequate size available. A configured Context Data Buffer Pool shall be searched in order to find a buffer with the same size as the reported context data, or find the next larger buffer. These buffers shall be handled and filtered asynchronously in the IdsM_MainFunction service."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00706",
   "text": "Once an appropriate Context Data Buffer has been found, it shall be linked to the corresponding Event Buffer for further processing."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00707",
   "text": "In case there is no appropriate Context Data Buffer of the same size or larger than the context data, the event shall be processed as an event without context data. Thus no context data buffer shall be linked to the processed SEv."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00708",
   "text": "In case no appropriate Context Data Buffer is found. The IdsM internal SEv 'No Context Data Buffer Avail- able' shall be triggered, in case it has been configured."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00709",
   "text": "Upon reception of a SEv with no context data, the IdsM shall not use any Context Data Buffer . Thus no context data buffer will be linked to the processed SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00801",
   "text": "The security events reported by IdsM module are listed in [SWS_IdsM_91015]."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00802",
   "text": "In case the IdsM Internal Events are configured, the IdsM shall provide own buffers for each one of these SEv s. These are dedicated buffers, inde- pendent from the common Event Buffer s used for normal SEv s."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00803",
   "text": "IdsM internal SEv s shall not be filtered by IdsM instance spe- cific filters."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00804",
   "text": "IdsM internal SEv s can be filtered by IdsM SEvID specific fil- ters."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00901",
   "text": "The IdsM shall store the SEv s in the Event Buffer s and pro- cess them asynchronously in the IdsM_MainFunction service in order to identify them as QSEv s."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00902",
   "text": "The qualification of reported security events shall take place by evaluating the processed SEv against a configurable sequence of filters, known as the filter chain ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00903",
   "text": "A SEv shall contain the information of the filter chain that is used to qualify it into a QSEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00904",
   "text": "Each filter shall reject a processed SEv in case the filter criteria are not met by dropping it."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00905",
   "text": "Otherwise, if a filter does not drop a SEv , the filter shall forward the currently processed SEv to the next filter in the chain."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_00906",
   "text": "A filter shall be able to modify the SEv s counter according to their algorithm, if they are of type sampling or aggregation."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01001",
   "text": "Filter chain selection When a SEv is reported, the IdsM shall apply the filter chain that is mapped to it."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01002",
   "text": "Filter chain evaluation IdsM shall evaluate the filter chain after evaluating the reporting mode."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01003",
   "text": "Possible Filters Each filter chain may consist of the following filters: • BlockState Filter • Forward Every nth Filter • Event Aggregation Filter • Event Threshold Filter • Event Rate Limitation • Traffic Limitation"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01004",
   "text": "Filter chain order IdsM shall evaluate all activated filter in the order BlockState Filter, Forward-Every-nth Filter, Event Aggregation Filter, Event Threshold Filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01005",
   "text": "Dropping of SEvs If the evaluation of one filter leads to dropping the SEv , IdsM shall not evaluate any additional filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01010",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a reporting mode filter for each instance of SEv ID. This Filter is mandatory for each configured SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01011",
   "text": "The reporting mode filter shall not part of a filter chain. It shall be directly linked to the respective SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01012",
   "text": "Reporting Mode IdsM shall determine the default report- ing mode of each reported SEv from the IdsMReportingModeFilter ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01013",
   "text": "Reporting Mode Options IdsM shall handle a reported SEv depending on its reporting mode according to Table Table 7.1."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01020",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a block state filter. See IdsMBlock- StateFilter ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01021",
   "text": "The block state filter shall represent a list of states in which the collection of the SEv s shall be blocked (the SEv s shall be dropped)."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01022",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be inform, by the BswM module, about the current state with the callback service IdsM_BswM_StateChanged . This information shall be used when a block state filter is processed in the main function asynchronously."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01023",
   "text": "Block State Filter If IdsM evaluates the Block State Filter and the current block state equals one of the states referenced by IdsMBlockState , then IdsM shall drop the SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01024",
   "text": "The block state filter shall forward the SEv to the next filter in the chain if the current state is not part of the list. In case this is the last filter in the chain, the filter forwards the QSEv to the sink."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01030",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide Forward Every Nth filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01031",
   "text": "Sampling Filter If IdsM evaluates the sampling filter for a SEv , IdsM shall drop all the SEv s but every nth , where n is defined in IdsMNthParam- eter . Forwarding of SEv s starts with the first received SEv. Then every nth SEv is forwarded."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01032",
   "text": "Sampling Filter Initialization IdsM shall initialize the sampling filter for a SEv so that the first received SEv is forwarded."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01033",
   "text": "The forwarding of the SEv s by the Forward Every Nth filter shall be done without modification of SEv data."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01040",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide an aggregation filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01041",
   "text": "Configuration of Event Aggregation Filter The parameter IdsMEventAggregationTimeInterval shall represent the duration of the interval during which SEv s of the given type shall be aggregated."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01042",
   "text": "The aggregation filter shall forward a SEv with the sum of the SEv 's counters processed in an interval. Considering the configuration for a specific SEv , of the aggregation filter's time interval with value l j for IdsMEventAggrega- tionTimeInterval , the filter shall count the number of events of the same ID j received during a single aggregation time interval l j"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01043",
   "text": "No Event Forwarding During Interval The aggregation filter shall not forward (i.e., to the next filter) any incoming SEv during the aggregation inter- val."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01044",
   "text": "End of Interval: No Event If no SEv of the same event type has been received by the aggregation filter in the past aggregation interval, no action shall be taken."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01045",
   "text": "End of Interval: One or More Events If one or more SEv of the same event type have been received by the aggregation filter in the past aggregation interval, a SEv shall be forwarded to the next filter in the chain."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01046",
   "text": "End of Interval: Count If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain, the count parameter of the SEv shall equal the sum of all count parameters of all SEv s of given event type processed by the aggregation filter in the past time interval."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01047",
   "text": "End of Interval: First Context Data If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain and if IdsMContextDataSourceSelector equals IDSM_FILTERS_CTX_USE_FIRST, then the context data shall equal the first context data of an SEv of given type that has been received at the aggregation filter in the past time interval."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01048",
   "text": "End of Interval: Last Context Data If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain and if IdsMContextDataSourceSelector equals IDSM_FILTERS_CTX_USE_LAST, then the context data shall equal the last context data of an SEv of given type that has been received at the aggregation filter in the past time interval."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01049",
   "text": "End of Interval: Timestamp If the SEv is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain, the timestamp shall be taken from the same SEv from which the context data comes from (configured in IdsMContextDataSourceSelector )."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01050",
   "text": "The time interval for each aggregation filter IdsMEventAggre- gationTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the main function period IdsMMain- FunctionPeriod ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01051",
   "text": "The counting of the time interval for the aggregation filter IdsMEventAggregationTimeInterval shall start with the first call of the main function."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01060",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a threshold filter."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01061",
   "text": "Event Dropping Below Threshold The threshold filter shall drop an SEv of given type if the sum of count parameters of all SEv s of given type that were processed by the event threshold filter in the current threshold interval is smaller than the configured parameter IdsMEventThresholdNumber ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01062",
   "text": "Event Forwarding Above Threshold The threshold filter shall forward an SEv of given type if the sum of count parameters of all SEv s of given type that were processed by the event threshold filter in the current threshold interval is equal to or greater than the configured parameter IdsMEventThresholdNumber ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01063",
   "text": "The counter of the events shall reset every time the threshold interval expires."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01064",
   "text": "The configured time interval for each threshold filter IdsMEventThresholdTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the IdsMMainFunc- tionPeriod ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01065",
   "text": "The counting of the time interval for the threshold filter IdsMEventThresholdTimeInterval shall start with the first call of the main func- tion."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01070",
   "text": "Rate and Traffic Limitation Before sending a QSEv to the IdsR , IdsM shall apply rate and traffic limitation that can lead to dropping the QSEv from transmission to the IdsR ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01080",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a rate limitation filter. This filter speci- fies a limit in number of SEv s and an interval in milliseconds."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01081",
   "text": "Rate Limitation IdsM shall drop an QSEv from transmission, if its transmission would cause the number of QSEv s transmitted in the current interval ( specified in IdsMRateLimitationTimeInterval ), to exceed the maximum num- ber of transmission, configured in IdsMRateLimitationMaximumEvents ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01082",
   "text": "The time interval for the event rate limitation filter IdsMRate- LimitationTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the main function period IdsM- MainFunctionPeriod ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01090",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide a traffic limitation filter. This filter spec- ifies a limit in bytes and an interval in milliseconds."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01091",
   "text": "Traffic Limitation IdsM shall drop an QSEv from transmission, if its transmission would cause the number of bytes transmitted in the current in- terval (specified in IdsMTrafficLimitationTimeInterval ), to exceed the max- imum number of bytes, configured in IdsMTrafficLimitationMaximumBytes ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01092",
   "text": "The time interval for the traffic limitation filter IdsMTraffi- cLimitationTimeInterval shall be a multiple of the main function period IdsM- MainFunctionPeriod ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01093",
   "text": "The IdsM shall reset the byte counter to 0 when the interval IdsMTrafficLimitationTimeInterval expires."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01094",
   "text": "In case the number of bytes trying to be sent dur- ing a time period exceeds the maximum number of transmitted bytes IdsMTrafficLimitationMaximumBytes , The IdsM shall trigger the internal SEv IDSM_INTERNAL_EVENT_TRAFFIC_LIMITATION_EXCEEDED if configured."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01100",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to add an additional IDS Message Timestamp field to the QSEv . The timestamp feature is optional and shall be acti- vated and configured globally for all QSEv s with IdsMTimestampOption ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01101",
   "text": "In case the SEv s do not contain the optional information of a timestamp (the sensor does not include it when it reports a SEv to the IdsM), the IdsM shall request the timestamp information from the configured source in IdsMTimes- tampOption ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01103",
   "text": "The option None in IdsMTimestampOption shall disable the timestamp feature."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01104",
   "text": "The option AUTOSAR in IdsMTimestampOption shall en- able the timestamp feature and determines that the source of the timestamp is the AUTOSAR StbM module by calling the function StbM_GetCurrentTime ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01105",
   "text": "The option Custom in IdsMTimestampOption shall enable the timestamp feature and determines that the source of the timestamp is provided by the application software."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01106",
   "text": "Timestamps are optional If the parameter IdsMTimestam- pOption is equals None , the IdsM shall not add a timestamp to a QSEv . The IdsM shall ignore timestamps provided via the timestamp parameter of the event reporting interface."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01107",
   "text": "Timestamps provided by the stack If IdsMTimestampOp- tion is set to \"`AUTOSAR\"' and the SEv is reported without a timestamp parameter, 33 of 104 Document ID 977: AUTOSAR_SWS_IntrusionDetectionSystemManager Specification of Intrusion Detection System Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 then IdsM shall add a timestamp from the StbM to the stored and transmitted QSEv s."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01108",
   "text": "Timestamp provided via event reporting interface If the timestamp feature is enabled and the SEv is reported with a timestamp parameter via the services IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount or IdsM_SetSe- curityEventWithTimestampCountContextData , then IdsM shall use this pro- vided timestamp parameter for transmission or storage of the QSEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01109",
   "text": "Timestamp provided via application software If IdsMTimes- tampOption is set to \"`Custom\"', and the SEv is reported without a timestamp param- eter, then IdsM shall request a timestamp from the application via the Timestamp- Provider callback and add the received timestamp to the QSEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01110",
   "text": "Truncation of timestamp parameter If the SEv is reported with a timestamp parameter, then IdsM shall truncate this value by the 2 most-significant bits, i.e., only keep the 62 least-significant bits for further use."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01111",
   "text": "If the option Custom in IdsMTimestampOption is enabled, the IdsM shall use the Client Server Interface IdsM_CustomTimestamp with the op- eration Get , which the application shall implement, to request a timestamp from the SW-C via the Require Port CustomTimestamp ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01112",
   "text": "Timestamp not provided via event reporting interface If the timestamp feature is enabled and the SEv is reported without a timestamp parameter via the services IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount or IdsM_Set- SecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData , then IdsM shall set the op- tion bit for the time stamp in protocol header to 0 before the transmission or storage of the QSEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01200",
   "text": "The QSEv s shall have a defined structure independent of the sink it is being sent to. The components of a QSEv are listed in table Table 7.2. For further details of the IdsM Message structure refer to the [4, Specification of Intrusion Detection System Protocol]."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01201",
   "text": "The configuration of a SEv IdsMEvent shall contain a list of data sinks which are used for the resulting QSEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01202",
   "text": "The IdsM shall provide the functionality for forwarding qualified on-board security events QSEv s to other ECUs via the PduR module."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01203",
   "text": "QSEv transmission The IdsM shall be able to use the sink IdsR for the configured events. The IdsMSinkIdsR indicates that the corresponding QSEv shall be sent via PduR in a IDS Message to the communication network."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01204",
   "text": "Signing QSEv The IdsM shall be able to attach a cryptographic signature, with the same data format, to each QSEv . The signature feature is optional and shall be activated or deactivated globally for all QSEv s with the presence of a configured Csm Job referenced by the IdsMCsmJobReference ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01205",
   "text": "The IdsM's Csm Job IdsMSignatureGenerateRe- sultLength shall define the length in bytes of the signature calculated by the crypto services. It shall be configured when the signature feature is activated."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01206",
   "text": "In order to generate a signature by a Csm job IdsMCsmJobRef- erence , the signature generation shall be triggered by calling the Csm function Csm_- SignatureGenerate ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01207",
   "text": "If the signature is generated by a synchronous Csm job IdsMC- smJobReference , when the function Csm_SignatureGenerate returns, the signa- ture shall be immediately available."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01208",
   "text": "If the signature is generated by an asynchronous Csm job IdsM- CsmJobReference , the IdsM shall be informed about the generation of the signature by Csm via the Csm notification callback function IdsM_CsmNotification ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01300",
   "text": "A SEv s reported by a SW-C shall define a maximum number of bytes for the transmission of the context data. IdsMEventMaxContextDataSize ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01301",
   "text": "No additional Interface Option The SW-C Service Port Inter- face shall not provide additional information other than the optional context data when the option None is configured in IdsMAdditionalParameterOption ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01302",
   "text": "Additional Interface Option: Count The SW-C Service Port In- terface shall be extended by the parameter count when the option Count is configured in IdsMAdditionalParameterOption ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01303",
   "text": "Additional Interface Option: Count and timestamp The SW-C Service Port Interface shall be extended by the parameters count and timestamp when the option CountTimestamp is configured in IdsMAdditionalParameterOption ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01400",
   "text": "The IdsM shall send its data via a interface PDU ( IF - PDU ) if the complete IDS Message with its additional IDS Message Signature , if available, fits in a single Bus- PDU . Configured in: IdsMIfTxPdu ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01401",
   "text": "Otherwise, if the data does not fit in a single IF - PDU frame, it shall be send via transport protocol using TP - PDU s. Configured in: IdsMTpTxPdu ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01498",
   "text": "After the IdsM has processed the SEv s, the resulting QSEv s which have passed the filtering and have the IdsMSinkIdsR configured, shall be transmitted using the service PduR_IdsMTransmit ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01499",
   "text": "IdsM shall not call PduR_IdsMTransmit again before IdsM_- TpTxConfirmation or IdsM_TxConfirmation have been called."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01500",
   "text": "The IdsM shall receive the confirmation for the complete trans- mission of the IF upper layer Tx-Pdu by the PduR Module with the service IdsM_Tx- Confirmation ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01501",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to transmit segmented PDU s with the service IdsM_CopyTxData . The function shall be called several times, each call to this function shall transmit a segment of the Tx- PDU , until it has been completely sent."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01502",
   "text": "The IdsM shall receive the confirmation of the transmission of a segmented PDU by the PduR Module with the service IdsM_TpTxConfirmation ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01600",
   "text": "⌊ DRAFT g The IdsM shall provide a functionality for persisting on-board QSEv s, with their corresponding optional fields: context data and timestamp in Dem / Sem ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01601",
   "text": "⌊ DRAFT g The IdsM shall be able to use the sink Dem / Sem for the configured events. The Sem sink indicates that the corresponding QSEv shall be stored in the Dem 's user defined memory: Sem ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01602",
   "text": "⌊ DRAFT g The data stored in Dem / Sem is the complete IDS Mes- sage with its mandatory and optional fields."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01700",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to persist the parameter \"Reporting Mode\" of a SEv in the NvM."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01701",
   "text": "The write routine of the NvM block NvM_WriteBlock shall be triggered after the modification of a \"Reporting Mode\" value IdsMReportingMode- Filter has been successfully changed by the diagnostic services."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01702",
   "text": "If the persistence in the NvM block fails, the IdsM shall roll back the SEv 's \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter , to the value before the diagnostic modification."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01703",
   "text": "The IdsM shall be able to read out the \"Reporting Mode\" IdsM- ReportingModeFilter persisted in the NvM for the corresponding SEv s handled by the IdsM instance."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01704",
   "text": "In case there are no NvM values available for the \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter of the SEv s, the configured values provided in the configuration tool shall be used."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01705",
   "text": "The NvM block descriptor referenced by IdsMNvmBlockDe- scriptor , shall be a block processed during NvM_ReadAll ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01706",
   "text": "The supported NvM RAM block name shall be IdsM_NvMRamBlockData."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01707",
   "text": "The supported NvM ROM block name shall be IdsM_NvMRomBlockData."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01800",
   "text": "The diagnostic handling feature shall be optional. It shall be activated or deactivated with the parameter IdsMDiagnosticSupport ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01900",
   "text": "The \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter of a SEv shall be modifiable during run-time via the diagnostic services of the Dcm ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01901",
   "text": "The service IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start called by the Dcm module shall enable the IdsM to modify the reporting mode IdsMReport- ingModeFilter of a specific SEv . This service shall trigger the routine execution to modify the current reporting mode, and shall contain the new reporting mode value to be set."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01902",
   "text": "In case the reporting mode parameter in IdsM_- Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start is invalid, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_REQUESTOUTOFRANGE as its Dcm negative response and the func- tion shall return E_NOT_OK."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01903",
   "text": "In case the Security Event Definition Id used for the call IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start is invalid, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_REQUESTOUTOFRANGE as its Dcm negative response and the function shall return E_NOT_OK."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01904",
   "text": "In case the request to NvM to persist the new reporting mode fails, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_GENERALPROGRAMMINGFAILURE as its Dcm negative response and the function shall return E_NOT_OK."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_01905",
   "text": "In case the request to NvM to persist the new reporting mode fails, this IdsM service shall roll back to the previously configured reporting mode."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02000",
   "text": "The \"Reporting Mode\" IdsMReportingModeFilter of a SEv shall be readable via the diagnostic services of the Dcm."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02001",
   "text": "The service IdsM_Dcm_GetReportingMode_Start called by the Dcm module shall trigger the IdsM 's routine execution to request the current report- ing mode of a specific SEv ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02002",
   "text": "The service IdsM_Dcm_GetReportingMode_RequestRe- sults called by the Dcm module shall allow the IdsM to provide the routine results and reporting mode for the requested security event via a result pointer."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02003",
   "text": "Type of error Related error code Error value API function called with an invalid event identifier. IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID 0x0A API function called with a NULL pointer parameter. IDSM_E_PARAM_POINTER 0x0B API function called with an invalid data size parameter. IDSM_E_PARAM_LENGTH 0x0C API function called before IdsM has been fully initialized. IDSM_E_UNINIT 0x0D The service IdsM_Init is called while the module is already initialized. IDSM_E_ALREADY_INITIALIZED 0x0E"
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02101",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter securityEventId of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEvent against the configured security events, and shall report the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID when an unknown event ID is pro- vided by the service call. An unknown event is an event that has not been configured in IdsMEvent ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02102",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter securityEventId of the func- tion IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContextData against the configured security events, and shall report the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID when an unknown event ID is provided by the service call. An unknown event is an event that has not been configured in IdsMEvent ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02103",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameters securityEventId and count of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCount . The development error IDSM_- E_PARAM_INVALID shall be reported when an unknown event ID is provided by the service call or the passed count is equal to 0."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02104",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameters securityEventId and count of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData . The develop- ment error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID shall be reported when an unknown event ID is provided by the service call or the passed count is equal to 0."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02105",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameters securityEventId and count of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount . The development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID shall be reported when an unknown event ID is pro- vided by the service call or the passed count is equal to 0."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02106",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameters securityEventId and count of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData . The development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID shall be reported when an unknown event ID is provided by the service call or the passed count is equal to 0."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02107",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter contextDataSize of the function 42 of 104 Document ID 977: AUTOSAR_SWS_IntrusionDetectionSystemManager Specification of Intrusion Detection System Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContextData , and shall report the development er- ror IDSM_E_PARAM_LENGTH when the value of the parameter exceeds the maxi- mum configured context data buffer size. The maximum context data buffer size results from the largest configured IdsMContextDataBufferSize ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02108",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter contextDataSize of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData , and shall report the develop- ment error IDSM_E_PARAM_LENGTH when the value of the parameter exceeds the maximum configured context data buffer size. The maximum context data buffer size results from the largest configured IdsMContextDataBufferSize ."
  },
  {
   "id": "SWS_IdsM_02109",
   "text": "With development error detection IdsMDevErrorDetect en- abled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter contextDataSize of the function IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData , and shall report the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_LENGTH when the value of the parameter exceeds the maximum configured context data buffer size. The maximum context data buffer size results from the largest configured IdsMContextDataBufferSize ."
  },

Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description T…"

<h4>Rolle und Systemgrenzen des Intrusion Detection System Managers</h4>
<p>Der Intrusion Detection System Manager (<code>IdsM</code>) ist im AUTOSAR-Classic-Standard (Release R20-11) die zentrale On-Board-Komponente zur Erfassung, Pufferung, Filterung und Weiterleitung von sicherheitsrelevanten Vorfällen (Security Events, SEv) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00300" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00300">[SWS_IdsM_00300]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00702" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00702">[SWS_IdsM_00702]</a>. Sicherheitsereignisse werden von internen und externen Sensoren – softwareseitig implementiert in Software-Komponenten (SW-Cs) oder Basissoftware-Modulen (BSW) – über standardisierte Programmierschnittstellen an den <code>IdsM</code> gemeldet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00301" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00301">[SWS_IdsM_00301]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00600" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00600">[SWS_IdsM_00600]</a>. Die Kernaufgabe des Moduls besteht darin, gemeldete Rohereignisse über konfigurierbare Filterketten zu bewerten, um aus relevanten Ereignissen qualifizierte Sicherheitsereignisse (Qualified Security Events, QSEv) zu erzeugen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00901" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00901">[SWS_IdsM_00901]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00902" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00902">[SWS_IdsM_00902]</a>. Diese QSEvs werden anschließend an definierte Senken übergeben: entweder zur boardexternen Übertragung an ein Security Operations Center (VSOC) via <code>PduR</code> (Senke <code>IdsR</code>) oder zur On-Board-Persistierung im Fehlerspeicher über das <code>Dem</code> (Senke <code>Sem</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01202" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01202">[SWS_IdsM_01202]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01203" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01203">[SWS_IdsM_01203]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01600" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01600">[SWS_IdsM_01600]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01601" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01601">[SWS_IdsM_01601]</a>.</p>
<p>Hinsichtlich der Systemgrenzen gilt die architektonische Leitlinie, dass der <code>IdsM</code> keine semantische Interpretation der gemeldeten Kontextdaten vornimmt und eigenständig keine Beurteilung darüber fällen kann, ob ein Steuergerät kompromittiert wurde <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001">[SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001]</a>. Ebenso fallen aktive Gegenmaßnahmen und die Bedrohungsabwehr (Threat Response) nicht in das Aufgabengebiet des <code>IdsM</code>, sondern werden extern, etwa durch ein fahrzeugweites oder backendseitiges VSOC, realisiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001">[SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001]</a>. Das Modul interagiert über wohldefinierte BSW-Schnittstellen mit Nachbarmodulen: Fehlerüberwachung über <code>Det</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00101" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00101">[SWS_IdsM_00101]</a>, Zustandsüberwachung über <code>BswM</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01022" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01022">[SWS_IdsM_01022]</a>, Diagnose über <code>Dcm</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00103" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00103">[SWS_IdsM_00103]</a>, Konfigurationspersistierung über <code>NvM</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00104" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00104">[SWS_IdsM_00104]</a>, Zeitstempelbereitstellung über <code>StbM</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01104" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01104">[SWS_IdsM_01104]</a> sowie kryptografische Signaturen über den Crypto Service Manager (<code>CSM</code>) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01204" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01204">[SWS_IdsM_01204]</a>. Interpretation: Die Initialisierung des Moduls über <code>IdsM_Init</code> erfolgt typischerweise im Zuge der BSW-Startsequenz durch den <code>EcuM</code> vor der Freigabe periodischer Tasks <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00202" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00202">[SWS_IdsM_00202]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91001">[SWS_IdsM_91001]</a>.</p>

<p class="diagram-note">Kontextdiagramm: Einbettung des IdsM in die AUTOSAR-Systemumgebung und Interaktion mit Nachbarmodulen. Quellen: <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00101" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00101">[SWS_IdsM_00101]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00102" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00102">[SWS_IdsM_00102]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00103" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00103">[SWS_IdsM_00103]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00104" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00104">[SWS_IdsM_00104]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00105" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00105">[SWS_IdsM_00105]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001">[SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00001]</a></p>

<h4>Erfassung, Adressierung und asynchrone Pufferung von Sicherheitsereignissen</h4>
<p>Jede Instanz eines Sicherheitsereignisses (SEv) wird im System eindeutig durch ein Parameter-Tupel identifiziert, bestehend aus der externen Ereignis-ID (<code>IdsMExternalEventId</code>), der Sensorinstanz-ID (<code>IdsMSensorInstanceId</code>), einer internen Ereignis-ID (<code>IdsMInternalEventId</code>) und dem symbolischen Ereignisnamen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00600" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00600">[SWS_IdsM_00600]</a>. Die <code>IdsMExternalEventId</code> ist eine ecu-weit eindeutige Definition gemäß Security Extract (SecXT), wobei der Wert <code>0xFFFF</code> als ungültig definiert ist <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00603" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00603">[SWS_IdsM_00603]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00604" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00604">[SWS_IdsM_00604]</a>. Existieren mehrere Instanzen eines Sensors auf dem Steuergerät, differenziert die <code>IdsMSensorInstanceId</code> die meldende Entität; bei Einzelsensoren ist standardmäßig der Wert <code>0</code> konfiguriert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00605" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00605">[SWS_IdsM_00605]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00608" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00608">[SWS_IdsM_00608]</a>. Meldende Sensoren dürfen nicht auf die interne Ereignis-ID vertrauen, sondern müssen den symbolischen Bezeichner (<code>SymbolicNameValue</code>) des jeweiligen <code>IdsMEvent</code>-Containers nutzen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00601" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00601">[SWS_IdsM_00601]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00602" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00602">[SWS_IdsM_00602]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00606" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00606">[SWS_IdsM_00606]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00607" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00607">[SWS_IdsM_00607]</a>.</p>
<p>Zur Meldung stehen dedizierte API-Dienste und Port-Schnittstellen bereit: Einfache Ereignismeldungen erfolgen synchron über <code>IdsM_SetSecurityEvent</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00300" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00300">[SWS_IdsM_00300]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91002">[SWS_IdsM_91002]</a> oder bei Vorhandensein von Nutzdaten über <code>IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithContextData</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00301" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00301">[SWS_IdsM_00301]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91003" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91003">[SWS_IdsM_91003]</a>. Für sogenannte Smart Sensors existieren erweiterte Schnittstellen, die bereits vorberechnete Ereigniszähler und Zeitstempel übergeben können: <code>IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCount</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00401" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00401">[SWS_IdsM_00401]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91018" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91018">[SWS_IdsM_91018]</a>, <code>IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithCountContextData</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00402" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00402">[SWS_IdsM_00402]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91019" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91019">[SWS_IdsM_91019]</a>, <code>IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCount</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00403" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00403">[SWS_IdsM_00403]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91020">[SWS_IdsM_91020]</a> sowie <code>IdsM_SetSecurityEventWithTimestampCountContextData</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00404" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00404">[SWS_IdsM_00404]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91021" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91021">[SWS_IdsM_91021]</a>. Soll ein Zeitstempel ohne vorberechneten Zähler übergeben werden, wird der Zählerwert auf <code>1</code> gesetzt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00405" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00405">[SWS_IdsM_00405]</a>. Kontextdaten werden über Zeiger bereitgestellt und unterstützen eine Maximallänge von bis zu 1500 Bytes <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00501" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00501">[SWS_IdsM_00501]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00502" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00502">[SWS_IdsM_00502]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01300" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01300">[SWS_IdsM_01300]</a>. Die SW-C-Anbindung erfolgt portbasiert über <code>IdsMService_{EventName}</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91027" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91027">[SWS_IdsM_91027]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91030" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91030">[SWS_IdsM_91030]</a> bzw. <code>IdsMSmartSensorService_{EventName}</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91025" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91025">[SWS_IdsM_91025]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91028" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91028">[SWS_IdsM_91028]</a>.</p>
<p>Um die blockierungsfreie Ausführung der meldenden Sensoren zu gewährleisten, werden eingehende Ereignisse zunächst in internen Ereignispuffern (<code>IdsMNumberOfEventBuffers</code>) zwischengespeichert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00701" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00701">[SWS_IdsM_00701]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00702" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00702">[SWS_IdsM_00702]</a>. Kontextdaten werden in einem separaten Pool konfigurierbarer Puffer (<code>IdsMNumberOfContextDataBuffers</code>) unterschiedlicher Größenklassen (<code>IdsMContextDataBufferSize</code>) abgelegt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00704" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00704">[SWS_IdsM_00704]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00705" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00705">[SWS_IdsM_00705]</a>. Der <code>IdsM</code> wählt dabei den kleinstmöglichen Puffer aus, der die gemeldete Datengröße vollständig aufnehmen kann, und verknüpft diesen mit dem Ereignispuffer <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00705" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00705">[SWS_IdsM_00705]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00706" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00706">[SWS_IdsM_00706]</a>. Ist kein Puffer ausreichender Größe frei, wird das Ereignis ohne Kontextdaten weiterverarbeitet und das interne Sicherheitsereignis <code>IDSM_INTERNAL_EVENT_NO_CONTEXT_DATA_BUFFER_AVAILABLE</code> ausgelöst <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00707" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00707">[SWS_IdsM_00707]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00708" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00708">[SWS_IdsM_00708]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91015" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91015">[SWS_IdsM_91015]</a>. Steht gar kein Ereignispuffer zur Verfügung, feuert das interne Ereignis <code>IDSM_INTERNAL_EVENT_NO_EVENT_BUFFER_AVAILABLE</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00703" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00703">[SWS_IdsM_00703]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91015" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91015">[SWS_IdsM_91015]</a>. Für interne Ereignisse hält das Modul dedizierte Puffer bereit, sodass sie nicht mit regulären Ereignissen konkurrieren <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00802" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00802">[SWS_IdsM_00802]</a>. Die eigentliche Filterung und Weiterverarbeitung aller Puffer erfolgt asynchron in der Hauptfunktion <code>IdsM_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00702" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00702">[SWS_IdsM_00702]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91000" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91000">[SWS_IdsM_91000]</a>.</p>

<h4>Qualifizierungskette: Filterstufen und Ratenbegrenzung zu QSEv</h4>
<p>Die Transformation eines gepufferten SEv in ein qualifiziertes Ereignis (QSEv) erfolgt schrittweise während des Zyklus der <code>IdsM_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00901" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00901">[SWS_IdsM_00901]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91000" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91000">[SWS_IdsM_91000]</a>. Jedes Ereignis ist einer Filterkette zugeordnet, die verpflichtend mindestens einen Filter enthalten muss <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00903" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00903">[SWS_IdsM_00903]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01001" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01001">[SWS_IdsM_01001]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00002">[SWS_IdsM_CONSTR_00002]</a>. Verletzt ein Ereignis die Kriterien einer Filterstufe, wird es verworfen (Drop), und die nachgelagerte Auswertung weiterer Filter der Kette wird unverzüglich abgebrochen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00904" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00904">[SWS_IdsM_00904]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01005">[SWS_IdsM_01005]</a>. Andernfalls wird das Ereignis – gegebenenfalls mit modifiziertem Zählerwert – an die nächste Stufe übergeben <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00905" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00905">[SWS_IdsM_00905]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00906" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00906">[SWS_IdsM_00906]</a>.</p>
<p>Der Qualifizierungsprozess folgt einer festen, normierten Auswertungsreihenfolge <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01002" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01002">[SWS_IdsM_01002]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01004" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01004">[SWS_IdsM_01004]</a>:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Reporting Mode Filter:</strong> Diese Vorstufe ist jeder Ereignisinstanz fest zugeordnet und kein Bestandteil der Filterkette <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01010" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01010">[SWS_IdsM_01010]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01011" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01011">[SWS_IdsM_01011]</a>. Der Standardmodus bestimmt das Verhalten <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01012" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01012">[SWS_IdsM_01012]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91013" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91013">[SWS_IdsM_91013]</a>: Bei <code>IDSM_REPORTING_MODE_OFF</code> wird das Ereignis sofort verworfen. Bei <code>IDSM_REPORTING_MODE_BRIEF</code> werden vorhandene Kontextdaten entfernt. <code>IDSM_REPORTING_MODE_DETAILED</code> leitet das Ereignis mitsamt Kontextdaten weiter. Die Modi <code>BRIEF_BYPASSING_FILTERS</code> und <code>DETAILED_BYPASSING_FILTERS</code> leiten das Ereignis unter vollständiger Umgehung der nachfolgenden Filterkette direkt an die Begrenzungsstufen weiter <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01013" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01013">[SWS_IdsM_01013]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91013" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91013">[SWS_IdsM_91013]</a>.</li>
<li><strong>BlockState Filter:</strong> Erste Stufe der Filterkette <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01004" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01004">[SWS_IdsM_01004]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01020" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01020">[SWS_IdsM_01020]</a>. Der <code>IdsM</code> wird durch das Basissoftware-Modul <code>BswM</code> über den Callback <code>IdsM_BswM_StateChanged</code> über Zustandsänderungen informiert <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01022" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01022">[SWS_IdsM_01022]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91005" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91005">[SWS_IdsM_91005]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91017" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91017">[SWS_IdsM_91017]</a>. Entspricht der aktuelle Steuergerätezustand einem in der Blockliste definierten Zustand, wird das Ereignis verworfen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01021" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01021">[SWS_IdsM_01021]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01023" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01023">[SWS_IdsM_01023]</a>, andernfalls weitergeleitet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01024" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01024">[SWS_IdsM_01024]</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Forward Every nth Filter (Sampling):</strong> Lässt das allererste empfangene Ereignis passieren und danach exakt jedes n-te Ereignis gemäß Parameter <code>IdsMNthParameter</code>; alle dazwischenliegenden Ereignisse werden unverändert verworfen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01030" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01030">[SWS_IdsM_01030]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01031" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01031">[SWS_IdsM_01031]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01032" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01032">[SWS_IdsM_01032]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01033" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01033">[SWS_IdsM_01033]</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Event Aggregation Filter:</strong> Sammelt Ereignisse über ein konfiguriertes Zeitintervall <code>IdsMEventAggregationTimeInterval</code>, das ein ganzzahliges Vielfaches der Hauptfunktionsperiode sein muss <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01041" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01041">[SWS_IdsM_01041]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01050" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01050">[SWS_IdsM_01050]</a>. Während des laufenden Intervalls wird kein Ereignis weitergeleitet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01043" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01043">[SWS_IdsM_01043]</a>. Nach Ablauf des Intervalls wird bei mindestens einem eingegangenen Ereignis ein aggregiertes Ereignis weitergegeben, dessen Zähler der Summe aller Einzelzähler entspricht <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01042" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01042">[SWS_IdsM_01042]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01045" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01045">[SWS_IdsM_01045]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01046" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01046">[SWS_IdsM_01046]</a>. Kontextdaten und Zeitstempel werden dabei je nach Selektor <code>IDSM_FILTERS_CTX_USE_FIRST</code> oder <code>IDSM_FILTERS_CTX_USE_LAST</code> vom ersten oder letzten Ereignis des Intervalls übernommen <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01047" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01047">[SWS_IdsM_01047]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01048" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01048">[SWS_IdsM_01048]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01049" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01049">[SWS_IdsM_01049]</a>. Bei leerem Intervall erfolgt keine Aktion <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01044" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01044">[SWS_IdsM_01044]</a>. Die Intervallzählung startet mit dem ersten Aufruf von <code>IdsM_MainFunction</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01051" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01051">[SWS_IdsM_01051]</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Event Threshold Filter:</strong> Prüft, ob die Summe der Zähler innerhalb des Intervalls <code>IdsMEventThresholdTimeInterval</code> den Schwellwert <code>IdsMEventThresholdNumber</code> erreicht oder überschreitet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01060" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01060">[SWS_IdsM_01060]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01061" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01061">[SWS_IdsM_01061]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01062" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01062">[SWS_IdsM_01062]</a>. Ist die Summe kleiner, wird verworfen; bei Erreichen wird weitergeleitet <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01061" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01061">[SWS_IdsM_01061]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01062" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01062">[SWS_IdsM_01062]</a>. Das Intervall muss ein Vielfaches der <code>IdsM_MainFunction</code>-Periode sein und wird nach Ablauf zurückgesetzt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01063" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01063">[SWS_IdsM_01063]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01064" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01064">[SWS_IdsM_01064]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01065" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01065">[SWS_IdsM_01065]</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p>Vor der Übergabe an das Routing-Modul <code>IdsR</code> greifen obligatorische Raten- und Verkehrsbegrenzungen (Rate and Traffic Limitation) <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01070" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01070">[SWS_IdsM_01070]</a>. Die Ratenbegrenzung verwirft QSEvs, falls die maximale Ereignisanzahl <code>IdsMRateLimitationMaximumEvents</code> im Intervall <code>IdsMRateLimitationTimeInterval</code> überschritten wird <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01080" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01080">[SWS_IdsM_01080]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01081" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01081">[SWS_IdsM_01081]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01082" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01082">[SWS_IdsM_01082]</a>. Die Verkehrsbegrenzung überwacht das Byte-Volumen im Intervall <code>IdsMTrafficLimitationTimeInterval</code> gegen <code>IdsMTrafficLimitationMaximumBytes</code> <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01090" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01090">[SWS_IdsM_01090]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01091" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01091">[SWS_IdsM_01091]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01092" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01092">[SWS_IdsM_01092]</a>. Bei Überschreitung wird das Ereignis verworfen und das interne Sicherheitsereignis <code>IDSM_INTERNAL_EVENT_TRAFFIC_LIMITATION_EXCEEDED</code> ausgelöst <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01094" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01094">[SWS_IdsM_01094]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_91015" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_91015">[SWS_IdsM_91015]</a>. Nach Ablauf des Intervalls wird der Byte-Zähler auf 0 zurückgesetzt <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_01093" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_01093">[SWS_IdsM_01093]</a>. Interne Sicherheitsereignisse des <code>IdsM</code> unterliegen keinen instanzspezifischen Filtern, können jedoch durch ereignis-ID-spezifische Filterketten reguliert werden <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00803" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00803">[SWS_IdsM_00803]</a>, <a class="spec-record-ref" data-req="SWS_IdsM_00804" href="../../spec/record.html?id=SWS_IdsM_00804">[SWS_IdsM_00804]</a>.</p>
