Each SEv shall have an IdsMInternalEventId . This param- eter shall not be configured manually. The IdsM shall calculate the value of this param- eter internally and shall publish the value in the parameter. This ID is used for internal handling of the SEv s.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00601
▸ SWS_IdsM_00602 [SWS_IdsM_00602] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00602])
Konstituierend · requirement

Sensors using the IdsM API to report SEv s shall not rely on the value of the parameter IdsMInternalEventId . Instead, they shall use the symbolic constant (SymbolicNameValue) of the corresponding SEv .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00602
▸ SWS_IdsM_00603 [SWS_IdsM_00603] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00603])
Konstituierend · requirement

Each SEv shall have an external event ID IdsMExter- nalEventId , which is a global and unique ID per Security Event Type repre- sented by the ECU configuration, and it is defined in the SecXT .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00603
▸ SWS_IdsM_00604 [SWS_IdsM_00604] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00604])
Konstituierend · requirement

A IdsMExternalEventId with value 0xFFFF shall be consid- ered invalid.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00604
▸ SWS_IdsM_00605 [SWS_IdsM_00605] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00605])
Konstituierend · requirement

Each SEv shall have a sensor instance ID IdsMSensorIn- stanceId . This is the representation of the module number, in case there are many instances of the same module reporting to the IdsM.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00605
▸ SWS_IdsM_00606 [SWS_IdsM_00606] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00606])
Konstituierend · requirement

The combination of external event ID IdsMExternalEventId and sensor instance ID IdsMSensorInstanceId shall make the SEv s uniquely iden- tifiable within the configuration. This parameter tuple is represented by the Symbolic Name Value of the IdsMEvent Container.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00606
▸ SWS_IdsM_00607 [SWS_IdsM_00607] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00607])
Konstituierend · requirement

Sensors using the IdsM services shall report a SEv using the symbolic constant (SymbolicNameValue) of the IdsMEvent Container .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00607
▸ SWS_IdsM_00608 [SWS_IdsM_00608] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00608])
Konstituierend · requirement

Each SEv shall have a IdsMSensorInstanceId configured. In case there are several instances of the same sensor reporting SEv s with the same Event Definition ID in a ECU, the reporting entity shall be uniquely identified through the configuration parameter IdsMSensorInstanceId . In case there is only one instance of the module in the configuration, the value of the instance ID shall be, by default, set to 0 .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00608
▸ SWS_IdsM_00701 [SWS_IdsM_00701] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00701])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall have a configurable number of event buffers IdsMNumberOfEventBuffers , depending on the amount of configured IdsMEvents that are to be handled.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00701
▸ SWS_IdsM_00702 [SWS_IdsM_00702] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00702])
Konstituierend · requirement

Upon reception of a SEv , the IdsM shall store the event in an Event Buffer until it can be further processed. Event buffers shall be handled and filtered asynchronously in the IdsM_MainFunction service.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00702
▸ SWS_IdsM_00703 [SWS_IdsM_00703] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00703])
Konstituierend · requirement

In case no Event Buffer is found. The IdsM inter- nal SEv 'No Event Buffer Available' shall be triggered, in case it has been configured.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00703
▸ SWS_IdsM_00704 [SWS_IdsM_00704] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00704])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall have a configurable number of context data buffers IdsMNumberOfContextDataBuffers with different configurable sizes IdsMContextDataBufferSize in order to satisfy different sensor use cases.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00704
▸ SWS_IdsM_00705 [SWS_IdsM_00705] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00705])
Konstituierend · requirement

Upon reception of a SEv with context data, the IdsM shall store the context data in an Context Data Buffer with the most adequate size available. A configured Context Data Buffer Pool shall be searched in order to find a buffer with the same size as the reported context data, or find the next larger buffer. These buffers shall be handled and filtered asynchronously in the IdsM_MainFunction service.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00705
▸ SWS_IdsM_00706 [SWS_IdsM_00706] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00706])
Konstituierend · requirement

Once an appropriate Context Data Buffer has been found, it shall be linked to the corresponding Event Buffer for further processing.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00706
▸ SWS_IdsM_00707 [SWS_IdsM_00707] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00707])
Konstituierend · requirement

In case there is no appropriate Context Data Buffer of the same size or larger than the context data, the event shall be processed as an event without context data. Thus no context data buffer shall be linked to the processed SEv.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00707
▸ SWS_IdsM_00708 [SWS_IdsM_00708] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00708])
Konstituierend · requirement

In case no appropriate Context Data Buffer is found. The IdsM internal SEv 'No Context Data Buffer Avail- able' shall be triggered, in case it has been configured.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00708
▸ SWS_IdsM_00709 [SWS_IdsM_00709] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00709])
Konstituierend · requirement

Upon reception of a SEv with no context data, the IdsM shall not use any Context Data Buffer . Thus no context data buffer will be linked to the processed SEv .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00709
▸ SWS_IdsM_00801 [SWS_IdsM_00801] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00801])
Konstituierend · requirement

The security events reported by IdsM module are listed in [SWS_IdsM_91015].

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00801
▸ SWS_IdsM_00802 [SWS_IdsM_00802] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00802])
Konstituierend · requirement

In case the IdsM Internal Events are configured, the IdsM shall provide own buffers for each one of these SEv s. These are dedicated buffers, inde- pendent from the common Event Buffer s used for normal SEv s.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00802
▸ SWS_IdsM_00803 [SWS_IdsM_00803] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00803])
Konstituierend · requirement

IdsM internal SEv s shall not be filtered by IdsM instance spe- cific filters.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00803
▸ SWS_IdsM_00804 [SWS_IdsM_00804] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00804])
Konstituierend · requirement

IdsM internal SEv s can be filtered by IdsM SEvID specific fil- ters.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00804
▸ SWS_IdsM_00901 [SWS_IdsM_00901] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00901])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall store the SEv s in the Event Buffer s and pro- cess them asynchronously in the IdsM_MainFunction service in order to identify them as QSEv s.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00901
▸ SWS_IdsM_00902 [SWS_IdsM_00902] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00902])
Konstituierend · requirement

The qualification of reported security events shall take place by evaluating the processed SEv against a configurable sequence of filters, known as the filter chain .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00902
▸ SWS_IdsM_00903 [SWS_IdsM_00903] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00903])
Konstituierend · requirement

A SEv shall contain the information of the filter chain that is used to qualify it into a QSEv .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00903
▸ SWS_IdsM_00904 [SWS_IdsM_00904] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00904])
Konstituierend · requirement

Each filter shall reject a processed SEv in case the filter criteria are not met by dropping it.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00904
▸ SWS_IdsM_00905 [SWS_IdsM_00905] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00905])
Konstituierend · requirement

Otherwise, if a filter does not drop a SEv , the filter shall forward the currently processed SEv to the next filter in the chain.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00905
▸ SWS_IdsM_00906 [SWS_IdsM_00906] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_00906])
Konstituierend · requirement

A filter shall be able to modify the SEv s counter according to their algorithm, if they are of type sampling or aggregation.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_00906
▸ SWS_IdsM_01001 [SWS_IdsM_01001] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01001])
Konstituierend · requirement

Filter chain selection When a SEv is reported, the IdsM shall apply the filter chain that is mapped to it.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01001
▸ SWS_IdsM_01002 [SWS_IdsM_01002] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01002])
Konstituierend · requirement

Filter chain evaluation IdsM shall evaluate the filter chain after evaluating the reporting mode.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01002
▸ SWS_IdsM_01003 [SWS_IdsM_01003] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01003])
Konstituierend · requirement

Possible Filters Each filter chain may consist of the following filters: • BlockState Filter • Forward Every nth Filter • Event Aggregation Filter • Event Threshold Filter • Event Rate Limitation • Traffic Limitation

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01003
▸ SWS_IdsM_01004 [SWS_IdsM_01004] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01004])
Konstituierend · requirement

Filter chain order IdsM shall evaluate all activated filter in the order BlockState Filter, Forward-Every-nth Filter, Event Aggregation Filter, Event Threshold Filter.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01004
▸ SWS_IdsM_01005 [SWS_IdsM_01005] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01005])
Konstituierend · requirement

Dropping of SEvs If the evaluation of one filter leads to dropping the SEv , IdsM shall not evaluate any additional filter.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01005
▸ SWS_IdsM_01010 [SWS_IdsM_01010] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01010])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall provide a reporting mode filter for each instance of SEv ID. This Filter is mandatory for each configured SEv .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01010
▸ SWS_IdsM_01011 [SWS_IdsM_01011] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01011])
Konstituierend · requirement

The reporting mode filter shall not part of a filter chain. It shall be directly linked to the respective SEv .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01011
▸ SWS_IdsM_01012 [SWS_IdsM_01012] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01012])
Konstituierend · requirement

Reporting Mode IdsM shall determine the default report- ing mode of each reported SEv from the IdsMReportingModeFilter .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01012
▸ SWS_IdsM_01013 [SWS_IdsM_01013] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01013])
Konstituierend · requirement

Reporting Mode Options IdsM shall handle a reported SEv depending on its reporting mode according to Table Table 7.1.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01013
▸ SWS_IdsM_01020 [SWS_IdsM_01020] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01020])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall provide a block state filter. See IdsMBlock- StateFilter .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01020
▸ SWS_IdsM_01021 [SWS_IdsM_01021] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01021])
Konstituierend · requirement

The block state filter shall represent a list of states in which the collection of the SEv s shall be blocked (the SEv s shall be dropped).

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01021
▸ SWS_IdsM_01022 [SWS_IdsM_01022] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01022])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall be inform, by the BswM module, about the current state with the callback service IdsM_BswM_StateChanged . This information shall be used when a block state filter is processed in the main function asynchronously.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01022
▸ SWS_IdsM_01023 [SWS_IdsM_01023] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01023])
Konstituierend · requirement

Block State Filter If IdsM evaluates the Block State Filter and the current block state equals one of the states referenced by IdsMBlockState , then IdsM shall drop the SEv .

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01023
▸ SWS_IdsM_01024 [SWS_IdsM_01024] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01024])
Konstituierend · requirement

The block state filter shall forward the SEv to the next filter in the chain if the current state is not part of the list. In case this is the last filter in the chain, the filter forwards the QSEv to the sink.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01024
▸ SWS_IdsM_01030 [SWS_IdsM_01030] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01030])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall provide Forward Every Nth filter.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01030
▸ SWS_IdsM_01031 [SWS_IdsM_01031] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01031])
Konstituierend · requirement

Sampling Filter If IdsM evaluates the sampling filter for a SEv , IdsM shall drop all the SEv s but every nth , where n is defined in IdsMNthParam- eter . Forwarding of SEv s starts with the first received SEv. Then every nth SEv is forwarded.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01031
▸ SWS_IdsM_01032 [SWS_IdsM_01032] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01032])
Konstituierend · requirement

Sampling Filter Initialization IdsM shall initialize the sampling filter for a SEv so that the first received SEv is forwarded.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01032
▸ SWS_IdsM_01033 [SWS_IdsM_01033] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01033])
Konstituierend · requirement

The forwarding of the SEv s by the Forward Every Nth filter shall be done without modification of SEv data.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01033
▸ SWS_IdsM_01040 [SWS_IdsM_01040] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01040])
Konstituierend · requirement

The IdsM shall provide an aggregation filter.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01040
▸ SWS_IdsM_01041 [SWS_IdsM_01041] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01041])
Konstituierend · requirement

Configuration of Event Aggregation Filter The parameter IdsMEventAggregationTimeInterval shall represent the duration of the interval during which SEv s of the given type shall be aggregated.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01041
▸ SWS_IdsM_01042 [SWS_IdsM_01042] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01042])
Konstituierend · requirement

The aggregation filter shall forward a SEv with the sum of the SEv 's counters processed in an interval. Considering the configuration for a specific SEv , of the aggregation filter's time interval with value l j for IdsMEventAggrega- tionTimeInterval , the filter shall count the number of events of the same ID j received during a single aggregation time interval l j

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01042
▸ SWS_IdsM_01043 [SWS_IdsM_01043] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01043])
Konstituierend · requirement

No Event Forwarding During Interval The aggregation filter shall not forward (i.e., to the next filter) any incoming SEv during the aggregation inter- val.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01043
▸ SWS_IdsM_01044 [SWS_IdsM_01044] requirement IDSM
Unbewertet
IDSM ([SWS_IdsM_01044])
Konstituierend · requirement

End of Interval: No Event If no SEv of the same event type has been received by the aggregation filter in the past aggregation interval, no action shall be taken.

Eigenschaft: Konstituierende Modul-SpezifikationRecord-ID: SWS_IdsM_01044
